old_prefix_policy: new prefix only; reject V02/V03 profile; old data and pinned binaries retained

payload.locator: content ID is direct physical row key; no mutable locator and no previous-version chain
payload.map: payload-map/1 fixed 93-byte root, extent-page/1 full ordered non-sparse tree; child binds range/count/encoded length; leaves bind block size/CID/content offset

read_limits.logical_payload: existing QueryReadBudget charges output/source demands including decoded hits
read_limits.encoded_block_demand: request ledger conservatively charges all full blocks touched by each logical range, including overlap; independent from metadata; trace replay for shared producer/cache hits
read_limits.runtime_io: actual full-block transfers additionally consume producer I/O limit; metadata and payload SDK submissions tracked separately from wire RPC

memory.algorithm: scatter each bounded verified block batch directly to bounded outputs, release batch before next
memory.additional_shared_runtime_reservation: output bytes plus conservative four times current full-block batch bytes; no complete file payload materialization
memory.payload_resident_cache: none in PayloadArtifacts; existing decoded cache remains version/context qualified

publication.input: existing per-version staging OBJECT; stream fixed blocks
publication.visibility: persist/verify blocks and complete map, bind descriptor/seal, then head commit
publication.post_commit_cleanup: only confirmed committed version staging payload/layout/catalog/metadata cleanup; failures retained and retried after recovery, never roll back visible head

capability.scope: process-issued fixed payload/layout reader; issuer/key/revision/format/sizes match; excluded from wire and ContentId
capability.admission: new prepare/execute/publish/open reuses V03 all-candidate dependencies and execution lease
capability.already_admitted: do not reselect Exact/Latest between decode and block reads

recovery: force full map/block closure validation, metadata cumulative separately, stream blocks; no warm corruption masking

validation.frozen_n128: N128 K2 D4 depth2 seed20261013 width4; original raw/FS/index and runner clocks; pinned V03 and new V04 prefixes
validation.account_instance_license: authorized original shared account, database and license; no isolated instance or new accounts
